title: Record the direct frame stage bills
body:
## Summary
- On the direct profile of one rank-7 and one rank-8 move per live port, the retained odd-stage idle schedule exceeds capacity by `111 * 32 = 3552` at every odd stage count.
- The 5, 9 and 11 stage zero-saving bills are `145/144`, `513/512` and `781/780`.
- No new kappa. The checker applies the pinned idle rules and does not replay bridge columns.
